narrative:
Carroll County has 17,716 registered voters, with 54.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 15.0%, a pronounced Republican lean of 15.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 33.9% of registrants.
